components.notes: Language: the {neg,to}-fragment, announced as the selected language and defined as Fm_{neg,to} (formulas built from variables by neg and to) inside Fm_CPL (sheet line 7; setting lines 35-38). Axiom schemas A1-A3 and MP are displayed on the sheet (lines 8-11) and restated in the body (lines 124-131). Assumption convention: a derivation from Gamma is a finite sequence whose members are in Gamma, are schema instances, or follow by MP from earlier members; a member of Gamma may be written at any line, MP has no side condition, and a premise is removed only by the deduction theorem (def:p02-hilbert-derivation lines 15-21; body lines 103-106, 129-131). The narrower language is announced, with the full-language translation def:p02-hilbert-translation.

Statement with exact premise scope: for every set Gamma (arbitrary, not only finite) and all phi, psi of the fragment, Gamma u {phi} |- psi iff Gamma |- phi -> psi. The annex proof writes both directions: right to left by reusing the derivation, adding phi and one MP step; left to right by induction over the lines theta_i of a derivation from Gamma u {phi}, with the cases member of Gamma or axiom (A1 instance plus MP), theta_i = phi (explicit A1/A2/MP derivation of phi -> phi), and MP (A2 instance plus two MP steps), and the closing remark that these exhaust the licensing clauses. The sheet records the premise-sensitivity condition (MP is the only rule; uniform substitution does not act on assumptions), and the body records that the proof holds for arbitrary Gamma from A1, A2 and MP alone.

components.notes: Translations in both directions between the Hilbert calculus and each selected presentation (sheet:nd-cpl with labelled nonvacuous discharge; the propositional rows of sheet:lk including Cut and Mix): H to ND, ND to H (through tr_H, with the partial-discharge inclusion (*)), H to LK (cut-free axiom derivations, two Cuts per MP line), LK to H (Mix replaced by contractions and one Cut, then the LK-to-ND half of annex:p7.calculi.3, then ND to H). Each theorem carries proved=<annex item>, and every annex item writes its construction case by case, including the eight derived Hilbert theorems as numbered line derivations and the eight rule images. The equivalence is Corollary thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-hilbert-equivalence (ND iff H for arbitrary Gamma; LK iff H for finite Gamma; fragment case), proved syntactically, and Theorem thm:p02-calculi-derivability-equivalence (finite Gamma; semantic, ND, LK and Hilbert legs), whose annex proof combines the corollary with the proved thm:prop-completeness and thm:prop-nd-soundness. Dependencies checked for written proofs: lem:nd-substitution, annex:p7.calculi.3 (both halves), thm:prop-completeness, thm:prop-nd-soundness. Explicit comparison: tab:p02-proof-systems (derivation object, rule families, adequacy form, proof-search behaviour per calculus), fig:p02-nd-lk-correspondence, the treatment-of-hypotheses comparison (body lines 103-119), the worked example through all three calculi, and the warnings on vacuous discharge and on size and proof shape. No domain is narrowed without announcement, and no step relies on a citation in place of a proof.

All three bounded subcomponents (GOAL-01, GOAL-02, GOAL-03) are supplied at proved standing. The original row's remaining defect ('ND/LK/Hilbert equivalence is cited') no longer holds: thm:p02-calculi-derivability-equivalence is now proved=annex:p02-w02b-p02-010-calculi-equivalence through explicit derivation maps. The original note ('no Hilbert system book-wide; cross-cutting list') is answered by the registry sheet sheet:hilbert-cpl, rendered in Part 14 and referenced from Part 2 and other parts. The home is Part 2 (propositional Hilbert section and the w02b-p02-010 translation section).
